items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And then I worked with Lil, worked with Lewis's wife, worked with Lil over to Dream.

ctx.x: I knew you said. Who else was in the band then?

Well, uh, let's see, he had, uh, uh, uh, Henry Gordon, pianist, and, uh, Buster Bailey. Oh, yeah. And, uh, Rudy, what was Rudy? Jackson. Rudy Jackson. And, uh, I think, I think Tubby Hall was with, was, I think Tubby, Tubby Hall on drums. I know he worked there for a while, I don't know when that was. No, I don't think he was there, I can't think of the name of the boy that was drum. Oh. Oh. Andrew Hilaire. I can't remember the drummer, because they changed drummers there several times. Who the drummer was? But,…
Dream. Who was the, uh, other members of the band and the clarinet or trombone?
